log.speaker: Teague Marrow
log.text: Since you ask. Three nights this month I have seen wing-shapes in the fog off the headland. Big ones. I wrote them in the log, and beside each I wrote: can't be.

log2.speaker: Teague Marrow
log2.text: Fog does things. But I have kept this light for thirty years, and fog does not do that.

lore.speaker: Teague Marrow
lore.text: The light burns, the log is kept. That is the whole of the job. Mind the cliff edge in the fog.

after_grave.speaker: Teague Marrow
after_grave.text: The bones on the shore, gone? I saw something go over the cliff at dawn, low and slow. I wrote 'gull'. It was not a gull.
